dialogues.speaker: Dietrich's Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"The sound of dancing drifted from my neighbors', it set my feet a-tapping, oh!"</color>

dialogues.speaker: Dietrich's Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"You're all smiling, the fiddle I'm playing,"</color>

dialogues.speaker: Dietrich's Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"And we're all dancing to and fro!"</color>

dialogues.speaker: Dietrich's Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>May his dreams be filled with wine and endless song.</color>
